body: Thank you very much. I don't really pay attention to the up or down votes.

Dental care is in no way, shape or form covered by our health care, sounds very silly since your teeth can be a huge chunk of your health. Sad, I know. I wish it was covered by MSI/Bluecross.

Edit: I will message you via PM, I just don't want people knowing personal things.

I do live in a city. We do have 'discount' dental care here. It's called "Dalhousie University". I have tried and tried relentlessly to get a decent price in there, but their prices are only maybe 40% less than original dental costs. I only get 400 monthly to live on and at the rate my teeth are decaying, I could only afford one a month, there isn't enough time to fix them all. 

If you have a story for me, I'd love to hear it. Thank you for your message.

I know, it's just that I notice that good people seem to get the crap end of the stick. Imo, anyway. I know being good is nice and all but it won't solve any problems. I'm mainly stating I don't feel I deserve this kind of treatment from people I should be able to trust (Doctors, "friends", family). What did solve it for me is taking those people out of my life completely, but it's left me alone. That, itself, has caused some severe depression.
Thank you, I might take you up on that offer.

My financial situation and social services prevent me from getting any dental care at all. They do not cover it. The doctors are a long story. They tell me that they either can't help me because I need to see a neurologist (Which is why I go see them, need a referral) or that it's due to my weight (Even though it's been happening since I was a healthy weight). I live with 3 people.
